articles.title_en: What Caused the US Pandemic-Era Inflation?
articles.title_cn: 是什么导致了美国疫情期间的通货膨胀？
articles.abstract_en: We estimate a simple dynamic model of prices, wages, and short-run and long-run inflation expectations that allows us to analyze and quantify the sources of recent US inflation. We find that, contrary to early concerns that inflation would be spurred by overheated labor markets, most of the inflation surge resulted from shocks to prices given wages. Although tight labor markets have, thus far, not been the primary driver of inflation, we find that they have a relatively more persistent effect on wage growth and inflation. Controlling inflation will, thus, ultimately require achieving a better balance of labor demand and supply. (JEL E12, E24, E31, E62, I12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个包含价格、工资以及短期和长期通胀预期的简单动态模型，使我们能够分析和量化近期美国通胀的来源。我们发现，与早期关于过热劳动力市场会刺激通胀的担忧相反，大部分通胀飙升源于给定工资下的价格冲击。尽管迄今为止，紧张的劳动力市场并非通胀的主要驱动因素，但我们发现它们对工资增长和通胀具有相对更持久的影响。因此，控制通胀最终需要实现劳动力需求和供给的更好平衡。(JEL E12, E24, E31, E62, I12)

articles.title_en: Uncertainty Shocks, Adjustment Costs, and Firm Beliefs: Evidence from a Representative Survey
articles.title_cn: 不确定性冲击、调整成本与企业信念：来自代表性调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the dynamic effects of an uncertainty shock on firm expectations. We conduct a survey that confronts managers from a representative firm sample with a model-consistent uncertainty shock scenario. An exogenous increase in uncertainty significantly reduces managers' expected investment, employment, and production in the short and mid run. We collect novel direct firm-level measures for different types of capital and labor adjustment costs. Adjustment costs vary strongly across types and sectors. They help explain firms' reactions to the shock, which provides evidence for the relevance of real options channels. We compare the findings to DSGE and VAR results. (JEL C83, D84, E22, E23, E24, G31, J23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了不确定性冲击对企业预期的动态影响。我们进行了一项调查，让来自代表性企业样本的管理者面对一个与模型一致的不确定性冲击情景。外生不确定性的增加显著降低了管理者在短期和中期对投资、就业和生产的预期。我们收集了不同类型资本和劳动调整成本的新的直接企业层面度量。调整成本在类型和部门间差异很大。它们有助于解释企业对冲击的反应，这为实物期权渠道的相关性提供了证据。我们将研究结果与DSGE和VAR结果进行了比较。(JEL C83, D84, E22, E23, E24, G31, J23)

articles.abstract_en: A model with two essential elements—sovereign default and distortionary fiscal and monetary policies—explains the interaction between sovereign debt, default risk, and inflation in emerging countries. We derive conditions under which monetary policy is actively used to support fiscal policy and characterize the intertemporal trade-offs that determine the choice of debt. We show that in response to adverse shocks to the terms of trade or productivity, governments reduce debt and deficits and increase inflation and currency depreciation rates, matching the patterns observed in the data for emerging economies. (JEL E31, E52, E62, F34, F41, H63, O23)
articles.abstract_cn: 一个包含两个基本要素——主权违约和扭曲性财政与货币政策——的模型，解释了新兴国家主权债务、违约风险与通货膨胀之间的相互作用。我们推导出货币政策被积极用于支持财政政策的条件，并刻画了决定债务选择的跨期权衡。我们表明，面对贸易条件或生产率的不利冲击，政府会减少债务和赤字，并提高通货膨胀率和货币贬值率，这与新兴经济体数据中观察到的模式相符。（JEL E31, E52, E62, F34, F41, H63, O23）

articles.title_en: Estimating Macrofiscal Effects of Climate Shocks from Billions of Geospatial Weather Observations
articles.title_cn: 从数十亿地理空间天气观测中估计气候冲击的宏观财政效应
articles.abstract_en: The literature studying the macroeconomics of weather has focused on temperature and precipitation annual averages, while micro studies have focused more on extreme weather measures. We construct hundreds of variables from high-frequency, high-spatial-resolution weather measurements. Using the LASSO, we identify the parsimonious subset of variables that can best explain GDP and key macrofiscal variables. We find that scarcer mild temperatures and an increase in the occurrence of high temperatures and severe droughts reduce GDP. These variables substantially improve the share of GDP variations explained by weather. Additional evidence suggests that fiscal policy mitigates these shocks. (JEL E23, E62, O44, Q54, Q56)
articles.abstract_cn: 研究天气宏观经济的文献集中于温度和降水的年度平均值，而微观研究则更关注极端天气指标。我们从高频、高空间分辨率的天气测量中构建了数百个变量。使用LASSO，我们识别出能够最好解释GDP和关键宏观财政变量的简约变量子集。我们发现，温和温度的稀缺以及高温和严重干旱发生频率的增加会降低GDP。这些变量显著提高了天气对GDP变异的解释份额。额外证据表明，财政政策缓解了这些冲击。（JEL E23, E62, O44, Q54, Q56）

articles.title_en: The Aggregate-Demand Doom Loop: Precautionary Motives and the Welfare Costs of Sovereign Risk
articles.title_cn: 总需求厄运循环：预防性动机与主权风险的福利成本
articles.abstract_en: I examine the role of households' precautionary savings motive in amplifying and propagating movements in sovereign spreads. I study this mechanism in a model where the government of a small open economy borrows from foreigners, but the debt is then partially held by heterogeneous domestic savers. In a calibration to Spain in the 2000s, I find that default risk accounts for about half of the output contraction. More generally, sovereign risk exacerbates volatility in consumption over time and across agents, creating large and unequal welfare costs even if default does not materialize. (JEL E21, F41, G51, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我考察了家庭预防性储蓄动机在放大和传播主权利差变动中的作用。我在一个模型中研究这一机制，其中一个小型开放经济体的政府从外国人借款，但债务部分由异质性国内储蓄者持有。在对西班牙2000年的校准中，我发现违约风险约占产出收缩的一半。更普遍地，主权风险加剧了消费在时间和个体间的波动性，即使违约未发生，也会产生巨大且不平等的福利成本。(JEL E21, F41, G51, H63)

articles.abstract_en: We examine how search frictions impact labor market sorting by constructing a model consistent with evidence that employers interview a subset of a pool of applicants. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for sorting in applications and matches. Positive sorting is obtained when production complementarities outweigh a counterforce measured by a (novel) quality-quantity elasticity. Interestingly, the threshold for the complementarities depends on the fraction of high-type workers and can be increasing in the number of interviews. Our model shows how policies like Ban the Box can backfire because when screening workers becomes harder, firms may discourage certain workers from applying. (JEL D22, D82, D83, J23, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过构建一个与雇主从申请者池中面试子集这一证据相一致的模型，考察搜寻摩擦如何影响劳动力市场分类。我们推导出申请和匹配中分类的充分必要条件。当生产互补性超过由一种（新颖的）质量-数量弹性所衡量的反作用力时，正向分类得以实现。有趣的是，互补性的阈值取决于高类型工人的比例，并且可能随面试次数的增加而上升。我们的模型表明，像“禁止询问犯罪记录”这样的政策可能适得其反，因为当筛选工人变得更加困难时，企业可能会阻止某些工人申请。(JEL D22, D82, D83, J23, M51)

articles.title_en: Fiscal Backing for Price Stability in a Monetary Union
articles.title_cn: 货币联盟中价格稳定的财政支持
articles.abstract_en: Fiscal backing is the idea that for the price level to be uniquely determined, fiscal policy must be active at least in some states of the world. We extend the fiscal theory of the price level to a heterogenous monetary union. Different combinations of national fiscal policies and a common fiscal policy with “Eurobonds” amount to active fiscal policy for the union. They all yield price-level determinacy but can have very different implications for the effects of fiscal and monetary policy. We propose how to coordinate the national policies and the common policy to provide fiscal backing reliably. (JEL E31, E52, E62, F33, F45)
articles.abstract_cn: 财政支持是指，为了使价格水平被唯一确定，财政政策至少在某些世界状态下必须是积极的。我们将价格水平的财政理论扩展到异质性货币联盟。国家财政政策与带有“欧元债券”的共同财政政策的不同组合，相当于联盟的积极财政政策。它们都能实现价格水平的确定性，但对财政和货币政策的影响可能具有非常不同的含义。我们提出了如何协调国家政策和共同政策，以可靠地提供财政支持。(JEL E31, E52, E62, F33, F45)

articles.title_cn: 名义贬值、通货膨胀与不平等
articles.abstract_en: We study the distribution of labor income during large devaluations. Across countries, inequality falls after large devaluations within the context of a surge in inflation and a fall and subsequent recovery of real labor income. To better understand inequality dynamics, we use a novel administrative dataset covering the 2002 Argentinean devaluation. We show that following a homogeneous fall in real labor income across workers, the bottom of the income distribution recovers faster than the top. Low labor mobility and lack of union coverage among high-income workers explain their slow recovery. (JEL D31, E25, E31, F31, F44, O19, O24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究大规模贬值期间劳动收入的分配情况。跨国数据显示，在大规模贬值后，伴随着通胀飙升以及实际劳动收入的下降和随后的恢复，不平等现象有所减少。为了更好地理解不平等动态，我们使用了一个涵盖2002年阿根廷贬值的新型行政数据集。我们表明，在工人实际劳动收入普遍下降之后，收入分配底部的恢复速度快于顶部。低收入工人的流动性低以及高收入工人缺乏工会覆盖解释了他们的缓慢恢复。（JEL D31, E25, E31, F31, F44, O19, O24）

articles.title_en: An American Macroeconomic Picture: Supply and Demand Shocks in the Frequency Domain
articles.title_cn: 美国宏观经济图景：频域中的供给与需求冲击
articles.abstract_en: We provide a few new empirical facts that theoretical models should feature in order to be consistent with the data. (i) There are two classes of shocks: demand and supply. Supply shocks have long-run effects on economic activity; demand shocks do not. (ii) Both supply and demand shocks are important sources of business cycles' fluctuations. (iii) Supply shocks are the primary driver for consumption fluctuations, demand shocks for investment. (iv) The demand shock is closely related to the credit spread, while the supply shock is essentially a news shock. The results are obtained using a novel frequency domain method. (JEL C32, E32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一些新的实证事实，理论模型应包含这些事实以与数据保持一致。(i) 存在两类冲击：需求冲击和供给冲击。供给冲击对经济活动具有长期影响；需求冲击则没有。(ii) 供给冲击和需求冲击都是商业周期波动的重要来源。(iii) 供给冲击是消费波动的主要驱动因素，需求冲击则是投资波动的主要驱动因素。(iv) 需求冲击与信用利差密切相关，而供给冲击本质上是一种新闻冲击。这些结果是通过一种新颖的频域方法获得的。(JEL C32, E32)

articles.title_en: Economic Winners versus Losers and the Unequal Pandemic Recession
articles.title_cn: 经济赢家与输家及不平等的疫情衰退
articles.abstract_en: During the pandemic recession, firms directly exposed to the virus—i.e. the “contact” sector—contracted sharply and recovered slowly relative to the rest of the economy. Less understood is how firms that “won” by offering safer substitutes for contact sector goods have affected this unequal downturn. Using both firm and industry data, we first construct disaggregated measures of revenue growth that distinguish between contact sector losers, contact sector winners, and the noncontact sector. We show that contact sector losers contracted roughly 50 percent more than the sector average, while winners grew. We then develop a model to explain the evidence. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, I12)
articles.abstract_cn: 在疫情衰退期间，直接暴露于病毒的行业——即“接触”行业——相对于经济其他部分急剧收缩且恢复缓慢。对于通过提供接触行业商品的更安全替代品而“获胜”的企业如何影响这一不平等的衰退，我们知之甚少。利用企业和行业数据，我们首先构建了区分接触行业输家、接触行业赢家和非接触行业的收入增长的细分指标。我们表明，接触行业输家的收缩幅度约为行业平均水平的50%，而赢家则实现增长。随后，我们开发了一个模型来解释这些证据。(JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, I12)
